text: On a successful 207 response with a DOM, tryURL replaces the working URL with response.url. Later principal and address-book home paths are resolved against that base. Preserve this explicit redirected base when changing request deduplication or phase handling. This is a current discovery contract; no redirecting server was contacted. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
